feeds.title: Snowminds
feeds.description: Become a ski or snowboard instructor. We are here to show you what's like to be an instructor! These instructor blogs are our own unique stories. Our Mission is to help ski enthusiasts getting their life's experience as a ski- or snowboard instructor in some of the worlds best ski resorts!

feeds.title: Yes Improvement Blog
feeds.description: Yes Improvement Ski & Snowboard Instructor Courses. YES is the longest running improvement & instructor training program in the world! As a result, the YES team is made up of some of the best ski and snowboard instructors around, all boosting CSIA Level 4 certification.

feeds.title: Roddy Willis Blog
feeds.description: Private Ski Instructor In Verbier. Improve Your Skiing Quickly And Efficiently With Roddy Willis. Anyone who wants to make big improvements to their skiing, whether you have been skiing for years or have only recently caught the skiing bug, Roddy can help you realise your true potential and achieve results beyond the expected.

feeds.title: Ski Bro Blog
feeds.description: Tips and Tricks from The Home of Ski Lessons. SkiBro is The Home of Ski Lessons - a single booking point for thousands of ski schools and independent instructors across Europe.

feeds.title: Ski With Tony
feeds.description: Ski Lessons in Portage, WI and Beyond. Hi, my name is Tony Herman and I'm a PSIA Level 2 Ski Instructor teaching at Cascade Mountain in Portage, WI. I'd love to ski with you and see if we can work together to improve your skiing.

feeds.title: Element Ski School Verbier Blog
feeds.description: Element Verbier ski school - private ski lessons, off-piste & ski instructor training. The ski school started for a very simple reason: two ski instructors had a chat and realised they had the same simple ambition - to work with a team of highly qualified ski instructors, have fun and make sure that their clients enjoyed skiing in Verbier just as much as they did.

feeds.title: Ski Thomas Blog
feeds.description: I live and ski in Méribel and worked as an ESF ski instructor. After many years in the mountains and the snow, my enthusiasm for skiing is as fresh as ever. The motion and the freedom you enjoy while gliding through a glistening and frozen environment, playing with gravity, is a sensation I crave for and don't ever want to miss! I would like to share that enthusiasm so that you too can feel the thrill of traveling through this beautiful snow-covered landscape.

feeds.title: Nordic Ski Coach
feeds.description: We are a small band of merry skiers with a diverse skiing background. We stand for fun on skis! It is not about racing or hurling yourself up and down a mountain, it is about going outside and enjoying the snow and the sport of nordic skiing!

feeds.title: JenBSki Blog
feeds.description: Become an insider in knowing where to ski, how to do it, and how to best book a lesson. I've skied for many years consistently, partaken in numerous Park City instructor clinics as well as having gotten certified as a nationally recognized instructor.

feeds.title: Ski Instructor Finder Blog
feeds.description: Find an instructor for your snowsports lesson. Our guide to help you prepare for your ski or snowboard lesson.
